title: JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS IS BIGGER AND NAMES THE LIFT
why: On the Undercroft floor the join button was 13 px lettering at the top edge, small beside the station names, easy to miss from the couch. It is now 20 px with a second line, or go up at ENTER RAID!, since the lift joins the raid in progress too.
now: JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS is bigger on the Undercroft floor and says you can also go up at ENTER RAID!

or go up at ENTER RAID!
'; // v16.xx: and the lift, which joins too
